researcher_notes: No existing GEM row matches: the roster has no Mississippi Hub row. EIA Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 722: Mississippi Hub Storage Phase 2, Mississippi Hub LLC, New Pipeline, Completed 9 Aug 2012, cost 75 million, 36.8 miles, 200 MMcf/d additional capacity, 24 and 30 inch, FERC docket CP09-110. A 2009 Federal Register notice from FERC (E9-17695) states the project builds 22.6 miles of 30 inch and 14.2 miles of 24 inch pipe in one corridor (sum 36.8 miles) in Simpson, Jefferson Davis and Covington Counties, with new interconnects to the Southeast Supply Header and Transco. EIA and FERC are independent origins. Length is over the 15.5 mile threshold. Pipeline name and segment name follow the project; check whether the team wants a different parent name. Expansion of an existing storage facility, but the pipe is new. No route found, no official GIS checked. Owner name already in the entity gazetteer style. Parent and ProposalYear left blank because no source was read for them.
